explanation.what_it_tests: Verifies the core math engine is 100% decoupled from host OS windowing & GUI frameworks.

benchmarks.name: Declarative Emergence
details: 7 distinct games/simulations generated from 2 universal primitives.
0 bespoke game loops or hardcoded heuristics in core engine.

explanation.what_it_tests: Measures combinatorial application emergence from universal primitives without bespoke code.
explanation.what_we_measure: Application-to-primitive expansion ratio (Target: ≥ 3.0x Multiplier | 0 Heuristics).
explanation.how_its_measured: Divides working application documents (7) by core spatial primitives (2).
explanation.how_to_compare: Higher multiplier = greater emergence; bespoke game strings = automatic failure.

benchmarks.name: Spatial & Universal Invariance
details: Evaluated across 5 extreme viewport resolutions (100x100 to 4K).
Maximum floating-point trajectory variance: 0.00000000e+00 units.

explanation.what_it_tests: Ensures simulation physics behave identically across all viewport resolutions (Watch to 4K).
explanation.what_we_measure: Normalized Euclidean trajectory drift across resolutions (Target: Δ ≤ 1e-7 | >16 Decades).
explanation.how_its_measured: Runs identical 60-step simulations across 5 viewport sizes and computes max coordinate variance.
explanation.how_to_compare: Δ = 0.0 = bit-exact resolution invariance; Δ > 0 = viewport distortion.

benchmarks.name: Physical & Conservation Fidelity
details: Tested over 1,000 distinct collision trajectories and impact angles.
Total kinetic energy conservation drift: 0.00000000e+00 units.

explanation.what_it_tests: Verifies collisions strictly conserve kinetic energy without numerical loss or gain.
explanation.what_we_measure: Kinetic energy variance in Parts-Per-Billion (Target: < 1,000 PPB).
explanation.how_its_measured: Simulates 1,000 elastic collisions across 360-degree impact angles and compares energy before vs. after.
explanation.how_to_compare: 0.0 PPB = exact physical conservation; High PPB = artificial energy damping or explosion.

benchmarks.name: Static Provability & Reachability
details: Fuzzed 10 mathematically impossible boundary, coordinate, and state conditions.
100% compile-time defect interception before execution.

explanation.what_it_tests: Catches mathematically invalid states, boundary breaches, and corrupt rules at compile time.
explanation.what_we_measure: Defect interception rate (Target: 100% Statically Blocked).
explanation.how_its_measured: Feeds 10 impossible boundary and state mutation fuzz cases into loader.py before execution.
explanation.how_to_compare: 100% = zero unhandled runtime crashes; <100% = unhandled fatal execution flaws.

benchmarks.name: Speed & Step Latency
details: Evaluated 10,000 full collision simulation steps.
Peak throughput: 37,359 steps/second (10.7x faster than traditional baseline).

explanation.what_it_tests: Measures physics simulation throughput and hardware step latency.
explanation.what_we_measure: Simulation ticks per second and microsecond step latency (Target: > 10,000 ticks/s | < 100 μs).
explanation.how_its_measured: Executes 10,000 continuous collision steps using high-resolution hardware timers.
explanation.how_to_compare: Higher ticks/s = faster execution; lower μs = ultra-low input latency.

benchmarks.name: Resource & Memory Churn
details: Tracked heap allocation delta across 5,000 consecutive simulation steps.
Total memory churn: 3.50 KB (Near-zero GC pause overhead).

explanation.what_it_tests: Measures steady-state memory allocation waste per step to prevent GC lag and frame stutters.
explanation.what_we_measure: Heap memory allocation delta per simulation step (Target: Minimal Churn < 500 B/tick).
explanation.how_its_measured: Snapshots heap memory before and after 5,000 steps via tracemalloc profiler.
explanation.how_to_compare: Near-zero bytes = smooth frame pacing with zero garbage collection pauses.

benchmarks.name: Structural Complexity
details: Audited AST branching complexity across 13 engine functions.
Peak function complexity: 21 (Zero unbounded spaghetti branching).
benchmarks.formula: v(G) = E - N + 2P (McCabe Graph Cyclomatic Complexity)

explanation.what_it_tests: Guarantees engine logic remains modular, simple, and mathematically bounded.
explanation.what_we_measure: Peak McCabe Cyclomatic Complexity score across all functions (Target: CC ≤ 30).
explanation.how_its_measured: Parses AST decision branches (if, while, for, bool operators) for every runtime function.
explanation.how_to_compare: CC ≤ 30 = provable, modular code; CC > 30 = tangled spaghetti logic.

benchmarks.name: Determinism & Reliability
details: Evaluated 50,000 continuous simulation steps in two independent execution runs.
Full Cryptographic Digest: 23a940449ab23ae357a8971a783b7648db68f0c6c4d50110ba57a528c34ec42c (Bit-exact match across runs).

explanation.what_it_tests: Guarantees 100% bit-exact simulation reproducibility across independent runs and platforms.
explanation.what_we_measure: Cryptographic SHA-256 state digest match after 50,000 continuous simulation steps.
explanation.how_its_measured: Runs two independent 50,000-step simulations and hashes all positions, velocities, and state variables.
explanation.how_to_compare: Bit-Exact Match = perfect replay fidelity; Any hash mismatch = non-deterministic divergence.

benchmarks.name: Bug & Tunneling Stress
details: Stress-tested collision containment under extreme velocity (2.5 norm units/s).
Zero tunneling or spatial penetration through thin physical barriers.

explanation.what_it_tests: Stress-tests collision containment to eliminate high-velocity barrier penetration bugs.
explanation.what_we_measure: Maximum containment velocity under extreme acceleration (Target: v_max ≥ 2.5 units/s | 0% Defect).
explanation.how_its_measured: Fires a 10x-speed entity directly against an ultra-thin 0.02 barrier over 60 steps.
explanation.how_to_compare: 0% Defect = bulletproof collision math; >0% Defect = object glitched through wall.

SHA-256 State Hash: d057887ea2cee0e4fee229a87d2ba387c1cefdf47564b06947bbdb29c8a5d3db
Two's-complement integer operations guarantee bit-identical results across x86, ARM, and WebAssembly.

explanation.what_it_tests: Eliminates IEEE 754 floating-point hardware divergence (FMA/rounding differences across x86, ARM, WASM).
explanation.what_we_measure: Cryptographic reproducibility of fixed-point integer state over 50,000 steps (Target: 100% Bit-Exact).
explanation.how_its_measured: Simulates 50k continuous multi-body collisions in Q32.32 math and hashes all 64-bit integer vectors.
explanation.how_to_compare: EXACT SHA-256 = universal cross-platform parity; Divergence = CPU architecture desync bug.

mlue_phase: Phase 1.6 (v1.6.0 SIMD Multi-Agent Vectorized Rollout Engine)

benchmarks.name: Substrate Decoupling
benchmarks.tier_description: Pure mathematical core; OS windowing driver isolated in disposable adapter.
details: Zero foreign OS/GUI imports detected in core runtime AST.

explanation.what_it_tests: Verifies the core math engine is 100% decoupled from host OS windowing & GUI frameworks.
explanation.what_we_measure: Foreign GUI/OS imports in core AST (Target: 0 Violations | Tier L1 Substrate).
explanation.how_its_measured: AST parser walks model.py, engine.py, loader.py checking against forbidden OS libraries.
explanation.how_to_compare: 0 Violations = portable to C/Rust/Silicon; >0 Violations = trapped in host OS.

benchmarks.name: Declarative Emergence
details: 14 distinct games/simulations generated from 2 universal primitives.
0 bespoke game loops or hardcoded heuristics in core engine.

explanation.what_it_tests: Measures combinatorial application emergence from universal primitives without bespoke code.
explanation.what_we_measure: Application-to-primitive expansion ratio (Target: ≥ 3.0x Multiplier | 0 Heuristics).
explanation.how_its_measured: Divides working application documents (7) by core spatial primitives (2).
explanation.how_to_compare: Higher multiplier = greater emergence; bespoke game strings = automatic failure.

benchmarks.name: Spatial & Universal Invariance
details: Evaluated across 5 extreme viewport resolutions (100x100 to 4K).
Maximum floating-point trajectory variance: 0.00000000e+00 units.

explanation.what_it_tests: Ensures simulation physics behave identically across all viewport resolutions (Watch to 4K).
explanation.what_we_measure: Normalized Euclidean trajectory drift across resolutions (Target: Δ ≤ 1e-7 | >16 Decades).
explanation.how_its_measured: Runs identical 60-step simulations across 5 viewport sizes and computes max coordinate variance.
explanation.how_to_compare: Δ = 0.0 = bit-exact resolution invariance; Δ > 0 = viewport distortion.

benchmarks.name: Physical & Conservation Fidelity
details: Tested over 1,000 distinct collision trajectories and impact angles.
Total kinetic energy conservation drift: 0.00000000e+00 units.

explanation.what_it_tests: Verifies collisions strictly conserve kinetic energy without numerical loss or gain.
explanation.what_we_measure: Kinetic energy variance in Parts-Per-Billion (Target: < 1,000 PPB).
explanation.how_its_measured: Simulates 1,000 elastic collisions across 360-degree impact angles and compares energy before vs. after.
explanation.how_to_compare: 0.0 PPB = exact physical conservation; High PPB = artificial energy damping or explosion.

benchmarks.name: Static Provability & Reachability
details: Fuzzed 10 mathematically impossible boundary, coordinate, and state conditions.
100% compile-time defect interception before execution.

explanation.what_it_tests: Catches mathematically invalid states, boundary breaches, and corrupt rules at compile time.
explanation.what_we_measure: Defect interception rate (Target: 100% Statically Blocked).
explanation.how_its_measured: Feeds 10 impossible boundary and state mutation fuzz cases into loader.py before execution.
explanation.how_to_compare: 100% = zero unhandled runtime crashes; <100% = unhandled fatal execution flaws.

benchmarks.name: Speed & Step Latency
details: Evaluated 10,000 full collision simulation steps.
Peak throughput: 13,289 steps/second (3.8x faster than traditional baseline).

explanation.what_it_tests: Measures physics simulation throughput and hardware step latency.
explanation.what_we_measure: Simulation ticks per second and microsecond step latency (Target: > 10,000 ticks/s | < 100 μs).
explanation.how_its_measured: Executes 10,000 continuous collision steps using high-resolution hardware timers.
explanation.how_to_compare: Higher ticks/s = faster execution; lower μs = ultra-low input latency.

benchmarks.name: Resource & Memory Churn
details: Tracked heap allocation delta across 5,000 consecutive simulation steps.
Total memory churn: 3.99 KB (Near-zero GC pause overhead).

explanation.what_it_tests: Measures steady-state memory allocation waste per step to prevent GC lag and frame stutters.
explanation.what_we_measure: Heap memory allocation delta per simulation step (Target: Minimal Churn < 500 B/tick).
explanation.how_its_measured: Snapshots heap memory before and after 5,000 steps via tracemalloc profiler.
explanation.how_to_compare: Near-zero bytes = smooth frame pacing with zero garbage collection pauses.

benchmarks.name: Structural Complexity
details: Audited AST branching complexity across 34 engine functions.
Peak function complexity: 27 (Zero unbounded spaghetti branching).
benchmarks.formula: v(G) = E - N + 2P (McCabe Graph Cyclomatic Complexity)

explanation.what_it_tests: Guarantees engine logic remains modular, simple, and mathematically bounded.
explanation.what_we_measure: Peak McCabe Cyclomatic Complexity score across all functions (Target: CC ≤ 30).
explanation.how_its_measured: Parses AST decision branches (if, while, for, bool operators) for every runtime function.
explanation.how_to_compare: CC ≤ 30 = provable, modular code; CC > 30 = tangled spaghetti logic.

benchmarks.name: Determinism & Reliability

explanation.what_we_measure: Cryptographic SHA-256 state digest match after 50,000 continuous simulation steps.

explanation.how_to_compare: Bit-Exact Match = perfect replay fidelity; Any hash mismatch = non-deterministic divergence.

benchmarks.name: Bug & Tunneling Stress
details: Stress-tested collision containment under extreme velocity (2.5 norm units/s).
Zero tunneling or spatial penetration through thin physical barriers.

explanation.what_it_tests: Stress-tests collision containment to eliminate high-velocity barrier penetration bugs.
explanation.what_we_measure: Maximum containment velocity under extreme acceleration (Target: v_max ≥ 2.5 units/s | 0% Defect).
explanation.how_its_measured: Fires a 10x-speed entity directly against an ultra-thin 0.02 barrier over 60 steps.
explanation.how_to_compare: 0% Defect = bulletproof collision math; >0% Defect = object glitched through wall.

benchmarks.name: Spatial Scaling & Broadphase Efficiency
details: Tested N=1,000 active entities (499,500 theoretical pairwise tests).
Broadphase pruned 499,290 non-colliding pairs (99.96% cull rate).
Evaluation throughput at N=1,000: 61 steps/second.

explanation.what_it_tests: Proves spatial grid eliminates O(N^2) pairwise explosion, scaling to 1,000+ entities without lag.
explanation.what_we_measure: Percentage of non-colliding entity pairs pruned before narrowphase physics (Target: ≥ 98.0%).
explanation.how_its_measured: Spawns 1,000 dynamic entities in a normalized arena and measures pairs emitted by SpatialHashGrid2D.
explanation.how_to_compare: ≥ 98% = O(N log N) scaling; < 90% = O(N^2) CPU bottleneck.
